data.long_meaning: The name Mapleeta is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘mapt’ which means ‘Amrit’, the divine nectar of immortality, and ‘leeta’ meaning ‘lotus’. This name symbolizes the divine grace and spiritual enlightenment associated with the lotus flower. The name Mapleeta carries the meaning “Mapt: Amrit (nectar of immortality), Leeta: Lotus” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mapleeta usually hope their child will grow to embody mapt: amrit (nectar of immortality), leeta: lotus and live with faith, good character and purpose.
